source_version: Capella (continuously deployed, no discrete version number)

concepts.label: Free Tier
concepts.reused_or_minted: reused - wording on this page is the short form 'Free Tier', yet another variant per the known wording-inconsistency issue

relations.subject: cloud/clusters/view-database
relations.evidence: You have at least the [Cluster Viewer](../projects/project-roles.md#project-cluster-viewer-role) role for the project containing the clusters you want to view, copy, or download.

notable_absence.finding: The cluster list's expandable-row fields and configurable columns (name, status, CSP+region, Server version, App Service link, CIDR, connection strings, node count, services, support plan, creation date/creator, cost) never include storage engine or storage-auto-expansion state, reinforcing that these aren't treated as cluster-identity attributes the way CSP and support plan are.

cross_component_finding: This page's filter list names the same four support-plan tiers as plan:*, but in yet another wording variant ('Free Tier', 'Basic', 'Developer Pro', 'Enterprise') distinct from both 'Enterprise Support Plan' (canonical label) and 'Enterprise Plan'/'Enterprise Service Plan' (previously flagged variants) - recurrence of the known wording-inconsistency anomaly, not a new one.
